name: YMCA of Southern Maine Summer and School Break Camps (Camp Heartwood & Camp Osprey)
description_short: YMCA of Southern Maine runs two co-ed day camps: Camp Heartwood in Biddeford, a mostly outdoor nature program on 26 acres with ten one-week summer sessions, and Camp Osprey in Freeport, with one-week sessions of traditional camp. Both also run February and April school break camps. Summer 2027 details are not posted yet.
swim_waterfront_notes: Camp Heartwood: swimming 3 times a week. Camp Osprey lists swimming among its activities; its December break camp has daily swimming.
